name: Electrical Measurements & Instrumentation
summary: The principles of measuring electrical quantities correctly: units and standards, errors and uncertainty, bridges, meters, power measurement and data acquisition.

topics.name: SI units, electrical standards and traceability
Measurement errors: accuracy, precision, resolution and uncertainty (GUM)
DC and AC bridges (Wheatstone, Kelvin, Maxwell, Schering)
Measuring resistance, inductance, capacitance and impedance
Power and energy measurement (single- and three-phase wattmeters, energy meters)
Data acquisition systems and virtual instrumentation
Grounding, shielding and guarding in measurement
